messages:
deploy-bot: Starting preflight for lightswitch cutover -> dedicated-eu1 for service/runtime tag=v2.3.0-rc3 commit=abc1234. Traffic plan: 10% canary -> 50% -> 100% over 30m. Change window: 22:00-23:00 UTC. @tia @sam notified.

tia: copying notes from staging run: KV cache warmup takes ~90s, CPU spike on shards 2-3 for first 3 minutes. Monitoring should watch token latency and OOMs.

sam: thx. who has the pin if we need to hold?

aleks: I have pin privileges. Will stand by. Also will watch GPU memory and qps.

deploy-bot: Canary group started (10%). Instances: runtime-dedicated-01-03. Image: redwood/runtime:v2.3.0-rc3. Preflight checks: kube-probes ok, infra-liveness ok, model-kv loaded.

maria: quick check: rolling update command used? paste below if needed.

sam: running the rollout with this command: `kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/runtime-dedicated --timeout=600s`

infra-bot: alert: node eu1-rt-02 > 85% GPU memory during canary ramp (03:12). Reactive autoscaler will not trigger for dedicated pools.

tia: seeing slight increase in tail latency in APM (p50 stable p95 +110ms). Not alarming yet but tracking.

aleks: pausing further traffic shift. Hold at 10% while we confirm KV eviction behavior. @deploy-bot hold-traffic --thread=1954321098

deploy-bot: Hold acknowledged. Traffic remains 10%. Canary timer paused. Reason: GPU mem spike + p95 increase.

sam: grabbing logs from runtime-dedicated-02: `docker logs runtime  | tail -n 200` -> seeing repeated GC-ish spikes around model kv refills. Pushing a small tweak to kernel selector might help but that's a patch.

maria: can we pin tag for stable fallback? what's current stable tag?

aleks: stable fallback is redwood/runtime:v2.2.7. I can pin routes to that if rollback needed. I want to see 15m more of metrics before deciding.

tia: agree. set a 15m observation window, if p95 still > +100ms or GPU mem > 80% we'll roll back to v2.2.7.

deploy-bot: Observation window started at 1954321200. Will post another update at 1954322100 or on manual action.

sam: FYI I enabled an extra KV prefetch on canary pod to reduce eviction churn, pushing as a configmap update now.

infra-bot: configmap rollout acknowledged, configmap/runtime-kv updated (change id cfg-778). Pods will restart during config apply.

tia: pods restarted, early signal looks better: p95 trending down to +40ms, GPU mem back to ~68%.

aleks: given improvements, I'll continue with 50% traffic shift in 5m. I'll run the ramp command then.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift initiated -> 50% at 1954321300. Canary group expanded to runtime-dedicated-04-07.

maria: running smoke tests against expanded canary: text-gen, embeddings, cache-hit ratio. All green except one rerank test failing intermittently.

sam: that rerank failure matches a model mismatch in v2.3.0-rc3 tokens ordering. Not a crash, but quality regression. How critical is rerank for downstream product?

tia: product impact moderate. We should continue ramp to 50% but do not go to 100% until we validate rerank. Opened a ticket: #INF-2135.

aleks: agreed. Pausing final ramp to 100%. I'll hold full cutover. If rerank failure rate >0.5% after 30m, we pin back to v2.2.7.

deploy-bot: Canary at 50% stable for now. Final decision pending INF-2135. Will post updates here. :eyes:
